instruction: Delete Google Chrome from the end of your favorites list.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing Google Chrome (the last app) from GNOME favorites. The evaluator checks that: (1) google-chrome.desktop is not in the favorites list, and (2) the remaining apps are exactly ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop'] in that order. This validates the user successfully removed the last favorite.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts GNOME favorites list state using gsettings command
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses rules dict keys
Verification logic is complete: checks both that Chrome is removed AND remaining apps match exactly
Edge cases handled properly: parse errors, invalid data types, empty results
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts list -> metric parses and validates removal
Expected values are correct: Chrome (google-chrome.desktop) is at bottom of initial list and should be removed
Order verification is appropriate for favorites list (exact match including order)
